Ultrarunner · Goodwin Generated Mission America

William Goodge

British ultrarunner, author of Rules for Running, and one of the most documented long-distance athletes of his generation. 3,011 miles across the United States in 55 days. 48 marathons across the UK in 30 days. 230 miles, non-stop, in a single effort. He runs in memory of his mother, Amanda, who died of non-Hodgkin's lymphoma in 2018. Every project he takes on is a fundraiser. Every mile is a tribute.
